hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Fixing a contiguous group of L potholes costs L + 1 units of budget.

hints.title: Efficiency Invariant
hints.text: The efficiency ratio L / (L + 1) strictly increases with L, so larger contiguous blocks must always be fixed before smaller ones.

hints.title: Greedy Budget Drain
hints.text: Identify and sort the lengths of all consecutive pothole segments descending. Deduct full cost L + 1 while possible; repair partially with any remaining budget.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Extracting contiguous segments and sorting lengths descending.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Fixing individual potholes or smaller blocks first wastes budget on fixed overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for segment lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that repairing longer segments first minimizes fixed setup costs per fixed pothole.
